usage: 三角形 is a noun for a three-sided shape, so you can use it with classifiers like 「個」 or 「塊」 depending on the object.
It often appears in simple school or geometry contexts, like 「畫一個三角形」 or 「呢個係三角形」.
When describing objects or patterns, 「三角形」 can be used as a modifier, for example 「三角形耳環」 or 「三角形圖案」.
In everyday Cantonese, people usually say 「三角形」直接指 the shape; there is no special verb form for it.
